items.titleEn: Guerrero Jr. (lower back tightness) exits game vs. Rangers
bodyEn: ARLINGTON -- Vladimir Guerrero Jr. left Sunday’s game against the Rangers in the fourth inning with what the team described as left lower back stiffness.

Guerrero, playing first base and hitting No. 2 in the lineup, had a base hit in two plate appearances for the Blue Jays, who are trying to keep alive their American League Wild Card hopes in the series finale at Globe Life Field. Toronto entered the game three games back of the White Sox for the final postseason berth and as losers in four of its past five games.
Myles Straw entered the game in his place in the lineup.

Guerrero had a stint on the seven-day concussion IL in August after a collision with Yankees shortstop George Lombard. He has also dealt with back and hamstring trouble during the season but has not needed time on the IL for either.

Guerrero has stepped up when the Blue Jays have needed him most, batting .292 with two home runs -- including his first of the season at Rogers Centre --, eight RBIs and a .796 OPS in 17 games in September. He also ranks second in the majors at first base with 10 defensive runs saved.

items.summaryZh: 多伦多蓝鸟对阵得克萨斯游骑兵的比赛中，Vladimir Guerrero Jr. 因左下背部僵硬在第四局退场。
bodyZh: 阿灵顿——Vladimir Guerrero Jr. 在周日对阵得克萨斯游骑兵的比赛中于第四局退场，球队将其伤情描述为左下背部僵硬。
Guerrero 本场比赛担任一垒手并排在打线第二棒，在多伦多蓝鸟力求在环球人寿球场进行的系列赛收官战中保留美联外卡希望时，他取得了两个打席一支安打的成绩。多伦多在赛前落后芝加哥白袜三个胜场，暂居最后一个季后赛席位争夺者的位置，且在过去的五场比赛中输了四场。
Myles Straw 在打线中替补登场接替他的位置。
Guerrero 在八月份曾因与纽约洋基游击手 George Lombard 发生碰撞而进入七天脑震荡伤病名单。本赛季他还处理过背部和腿筋的问题，但这两项伤情都未让他进入伤病名单。
在多伦多蓝鸟最需要他的时候挺身而出，Guerrero 在九月份的 17 场比赛中打出 .292 的打击率，包含 2支本垒打——其中包含他在罗杰斯中心本赛季的第戎本垒打——贡献 8个打点以及 .796 的 OPS。他还以 10 次守备跑垒分贡献（DRS）在大联盟一垒手当中排名第二。

items.titleEn: Cease (shoulder) undergoes MRI, scratched from next start
bodyEn: The Blue Jays' fight to stay in the American League Wild Card race may have been dealt a substantial blow, as the club announced Sunday that right-hander Dylan Cease had been sent back to Toronto for an MRI on his pitching shoulder on Saturday.

Although the Blue Jays were still awaiting results at the time of the announcement, Cease has already been scratched from his scheduled Wednesday start against the Orioles. Manager John Schneider was not yet willing to rule out the possibility of his ace returning during Toronto's final regular season series against the Reds.

Cease has reportedly been dealing with fatigue for a few weeks and is coming off a rough outing on Friday in which he threw 74 pitches over 2 2/3 innings of work. He allowed four runs (one earned) on three hits alongside a season-high six walks in a 7-1 loss to the Rangers.
On the year, Cease is 11-6 with a 2.40 ERA and entered play on Sunday leading the American League with 239 strikeouts.

据报道，Dylan Cease最近几周一直受到手臂疲劳的困扰，他在周五经历了一场艰难的比赛，在投了2.3局中用了74球。在以1-7输给得克萨斯游骑兵的比赛中，他被敲出3支安打丢掉4分（1分自责分），并送出赛季新高的6次保送。

items.titleEn: Soriano's uneven night deals another blow to Blue Jays' WC hopes
bodyEn: ARLINGTON -- José Soriano flashed brilliance but battled inconsistency in Saturday's 6-2 loss to the Rangers at Globe Life Field.

The 27-year-old threw five frames, giving up six runs on four hits while striking out eight and walking one batter. He appeared to fight the feel for his knuckle curveball, helping Texas build an early lead on a night when Toronto's offense took until the sixth inning to record its first hit.

The loss dealt another blow to the Blue Jays’ dwindling postseason hopes. The White Sox won earlier Saturday before the Guardians beat the Athletics, keeping Chicago in control of the third AL Wild Card spot. Toronto sits three games behind the White Sox and, because Chicago owns the head-to-head tiebreaker, the Blue Jays need to finish outright ahead of them to claim the final Wild Card spot.

Soriano began his outing by striking out Ezequiel Duran on an 84.9 mph knuckle curveball before Josh Jung connected on a first-pitch 96.7 mph sinker that leaked over the middle of the plate for a solo home run.

Texas extended its lead to 3-0 in the second without recording another hit. Soriano walked Wyatt Langford before striking out Jake Burger for the first out, then hit Nicky Lopez with a knuckle curveball.

Danny Jansen reached on a fielder's choice, with Langford crossing home plate when shortstop Andrés Giménez made a great stop to his right but yanked his throw across his body and past second baseman Josh Smith. The error allowed Lopez to advance to third, and he scored on a Soriano wild pitch with Evan Carter at the plate.
Soriano gave up an RBI double to Langford and was charged with two more runs after exiting in the sixth with no outs.

Toronto's offense didn’t provide much support, either. The Blue Jays entered Saturday with the second-fewest runs scored in the Majors, and Texas retired the first 10 Toronto batters despite starter Cal Quantrill exiting after recording just four outs.
Vladimir Guerrero Jr. became Toronto's first baserunner with a walk in the fourth, but the no-hit bid remained intact until Brett Bateman singled in the sixth.

Alejandro Kirk followed with an RBI single to center field to cut Toronto's deficit to 3-1. Davis Schneider, who pinch-hit for Nathan Lukes in the seventh, added a solo homer to left to cap the scoring.
items.titleZh: Soriano表现起伏，多伦多蓝鸟季后赛希望再受打击
items.summaryZh: 多伦多蓝鸟以2比6不敌得克萨斯游骑兵，季后赛希望受挫。
bodyZh: 阿灵顿讯——在周六于环球人寿球场以2比6不敌得克萨斯游骑兵的比赛中，José Soriano展现了出色的球威，但也饱受表现不稳定之苦。
这位27岁的投手投了5局，被敲出4安打丢6分，送出8次三振与1次保送。他似乎难以掌控自己的指关节曲球，帮助得克萨斯游骑兵在比赛早期建立领先，而多伦多蓝鸟的进攻直到第6局才敲出全场首安。
这场失利对多伦多蓝鸟日渐渺茫的季后赛希望再次造成打击。芝加哥白袜在周六稍早赢球，随后克利夫兰守护者击败了运动家，使得芝加哥白落后美联外卡第三名3场胜差，且由于芝加哥拥有对战优势，多伦多蓝鸟必须在战绩上直接超越南方才能夺下最后一张外卡门票。
Soriano在开局时用一颗时速84.9英里的指关节曲球三振了Ezequiel Duran，随后Josh Jung抓住了第一球、一颗投到红中偏高的96.7英里伸卡球，轰出阳春本垒打。
得克萨斯游骑兵在第2局在没有击出安打的情况下将领先优势扩大到3比0。Soriano先是保送了Wyatt Langford，接着三振Jake Burger抓下第一个出局数，随后用指关节曲球击中Nicky Lopez。
Danny Jansen靠着野手选择上垒，当游击手Andrés Giménez向右侧美技拦截后，跨身传球传向二垒时偏出并飞过二垒手Josh Smith。这次失误让Lopez推进到三垒，并在Evan Carter打击时靠着Soriano的暴投跑回分数。
Soriano在第6局无出局退场时，失掉一支带打点的二垒安打给Langford，并记失额外两分。
多伦多蓝鸟的进攻也没有提供太多火力支援。多伦多蓝鸟在周六赛前是全大联盟得分倒数第二少的球队，尽管得克萨斯游骑兵先发投手Cal Quantrill只投了4个出局数就退场，主队仍连续解决前10名多伦多打者。
Vladimir Guerrero Jr.在第4局靠着保送成为多伦多首位上垒者，但无安打比赛直到第6局Brett Bateman击出一安打才告破。
Alejandro Kirk随後击出一支中外野方向带打点的安打，将多伦多落后差距缩小至3比1。在第7局替补Nathan Lukes上场的Davis Schneider随后击出一支左外野方向阳春本垒打，锁定了球队此役的得分。

items.titleEn: Yesavage (meniscus) set to return on Monday after Friday side session
bodyEn: ARLINGTON -- Trey Yesavage threw a side session of around 30 pitches Friday at Globe Life Field that manager John Schneider said went well, potentially putting the Blue Jays right-hander in position to return as soon as Sunday.
“That kind of hopefully lines him up for Sunday or Monday,” Schneider said pregame. “Definitely based on how the weekend goes … likely Monday in a multi-inning role.”

A Sunday return would put Yesavage in position to pitch in the finale of Toronto’s crucial three-game series against the Rangers, with both clubs fighting for ground in a tight AL Wild Card race. If the Blue Jays hold him back until Monday, Yesavage would instead return for the series opener against the Orioles in Baltimore.

Yesavage landed on the injured list on Aug. 5 with left knee inflammation before undergoing surgery on Aug. 11 to repair the meniscus in his left knee. He made a rehab start with Triple-A Buffalo on Tuesday, allowing two runs (one earned) while throwing 34 pitches without completing the first inning.
The results were secondary to how Yesavage responded physically. His four-seam fastball averaged 93.3 mph in the outing, roughly 1 mph below his Major League average.

Yesavage is 5-5 with a 3.65 ERA, a 1.14 WHIP and 91 strikeouts over 93 2/3 innings this season. His return would give Toronto another option for multiple innings as the Blue Jays navigate the final stretch of the regular season.

Shane Bieber, meanwhile, is scheduled to throw off the mound on Saturday in Texas as he continues working his way back from right teres major inflammation. A return during the regular season is most likely off the table at this point, but Bieber is continuing to build up in case the Blue Jays reach the postseason.

“With the calendar [being] where it is, it’s going to be tough,” Schneider said. “Hopefully we can win some games and get to the point where he can be an option for us. He is going to keep plugging along as if this were the middle part of the season.”

“希望这能让他为周日或周一做好准备，”Schneider在赛前表示。“这绝对取决于周末的情况……很可能在周一担任投多局的角色。”
如果周日在对阵得克萨斯游骑兵的关键三场系列赛收官战中复出，Trey Yesavage将登板投球，目前两支球队正在激烈的美联外卡争夺战中竞逐。如果多伦多蓝鸟将他保留到周一，Trey Yesavage则将在客场对阵巴尔的摩金莺的系列赛首战中复出。
Trey Yesavage因左膝发炎于8月5日进入伤病名单，随后于8月11日接受了左膝半月板修复手术。他在周二代表小联盟3A水牛城完成了复健赛先发，投了34球失2分（1分自责分），未能投满第一局。

本赛季Trey Yesavage在93 2/3局的投球中取得了5胜5败、自责分率3.65、WHIP 1.14以及91次三振的成绩。随着多伦多蓝鸟度过常规赛的最后冲刺阶段，他的回归将为球队提供另一个能投多局的选择。
与此同时，Shane Bieber计划于周六在得克萨斯进行平地传球训练，继续从右侧大圆肌发炎的伤势中恢复。就目前而言，他在常规赛期间复出的可能性微乎其微，但Shane Bieber仍在持续增强体能，以防多伦多蓝鸟打入季后赛。
“考虑到目前的赛程安排，这将会很艰难，”Schneider说道。“希望我们能赢得一些比赛，让他能够成为我们的选择。他会继续努力，就像现在是赛季中期一样。”

items.titleEn: Cease's velocity, command an issue as Blue Jays slip in playoff race
bodyEn: ARLINGTON -- This is the time of year when every out becomes a little more valuable. On Friday night, Dylan Cease could only give the Blue Jays eight of them.

Cease lasted just 2 2/3 innings in the Blue Jays’ 7-1 loss against the Rangers at Globe Life Field, allowing four runs (one earned) on three hits while issuing a season-high six walks and striking out a season-low three batters. He threw 74 pitches, but only 36 for strikes as his command deserted him and he suffered another dip in his fastball velocity.

And this was hardly the night the Blue Jays could afford that type of outing. Toronto (76-78) still sits two games out of the third AL Wild Card spot with just eight games remaining after Chicago (78-76) lost to Detroit, but the Rangers (77-77) are now ahead of the Blue Jays. Toronto owns the tiebreaker over Cleveland (79-75), but not Texas or Chicago, leaving little margin for error.

“[I’m disappointed] with the lack of command,” Cease said. “If you don't have velocity or sharp stuff [but] throw strikes and execute, you can still get outs. But walks and [no] command at all is not a good recipe."

Friday stood in stark contrast to what Cease has done for most of the season. Among qualifying AL pitchers, Cease entered Friday ranked first in strikeout rate (35.3%), strikeouts (239), FIP (2.47) and opponents’ batting average (.180), while ranking second with a 2.40 ERA.

His fastball velocity, however, has become something to watch. A dip that first emerged in June continued Friday, when his fastball averaged 93.6 mph, compared to his season average of 96.9 mph. It averaged 94.8 mph on Sunday and 94.9 mph on Sept. 7.
In fact, Cease’s velocity was down by at least 2 mph on all five of his pitches Friday.
Cease did top out at 95.5 mph on his second-to-last pitch of the night, but neither he nor catcher Alejandro Kirk believes the lower readings fundamentally change how they need to attack hitters.
“I'm just trying to get in the zone and execute,” Cease said. “You know, whether it's 92 or 98 [mph], the name of the game is executing pitches. So that's all I'm really trying to do.”

“We don’t pay a lot of attention to the velocity,” Kirk added in Spanish. “Sometimes you don’t have your best stuff but you can get a lot of outs. It was a difficult night for him in terms of command, but he is a tremendous pitcher.”

The obvious question, particularly this late in the season, is whether the declining velocity has anything to do with health and whether it could lead to the Blue Jays giving Cease extra rest or skipping a turn through the rotation. For now, manager John Schneider said there have been no indications that such a move is necessary as the team pushes for a spot in the postseason.

“For a guy that's pitched as long as he has, and when you're communicating with him, we've got a ton of confidence and trust in our medical team,” Schneider said. “If there were some real red flags to where the player was putting himself in harm's way, it'd be a different story. He's grinding, for sure, and he's frustrated with the way the stuff is coming out. But I think if there were huge, huge red flags in terms of anything, he wouldn't be out there.”
Instead, Schneider believes Cease’s search for his usual stuff may be contributing to the command problems that surfaced Friday.

“A pitcher like him … you're kind of accustomed to pitching a certain way,” Schneider said. “He's reaching back for a little bit more, and it's not really getting [the results] right now. Then you kind of fall out of your delivery a little bit. [He’s] not sequencing the way he usually does, and the walks are just really uncharacteristic.”

The Blue Jays can ill afford many short starts from Cease. Injuries have forced Toronto into bullpen games and bulk-relief outings throughout the season, and the club has used off-days to operate with a four-man rotation at times to get Cease and José Soriano on the mound as often as possible.
Toronto ended up needing six arms to cover eight innings Friday.

“To me, it is one of the best bullpens, but we also need to help with batting and defense,” Kirk said after Toronto managed five hits and committed three errors. “We can’t let it all fall on the pitchers. We need to do our jobs, and we understand that.”
items.titleZh: 多伦多蓝鸟争季后赛失利，Dylan Cease球速与控球成隐患
items.summaryZh: Dylan Cease此役控球失准且球速下降，多伦多蓝鸟以1比7不敌得克萨斯游骑兵。
bodyZh: 阿灵顿——每年的这个时候，每一个出局数都变得格外珍贵。周五晚上，Dylan Cease只为多伦多蓝鸟投出了八个出局数。
在多伦多蓝鸟以1比7不敌得克萨斯游骑兵的比赛中，Dylan Cease在Globe Life Field仅仅投了2又3/3局，丢掉4分（1分自责分），被敲3支安打，送出本季新高的6次保送，并仅送出本季新低的3次三振。他总共投了74球，其中好球只有36颗，他的控球完全失准，同时直球球速再次出现下滑。
而多伦多蓝鸟在这个时间节点根本承担不起这样的投球表现。在芝加哥小熊输给底特律老虎后，多伦多蓝鸟（76胜78负）在常规赛仅剩8场的情况下，距离美联第三张外卡席位仍有2场胜差，但得克萨斯游骑兵（77胜77负）目前已经反超了多伦多蓝鸟。多伦多蓝鸟在与克利夫兰守护者（79胜75负）的交手战绩中占优，但对得克萨斯游骑兵和芝加哥小熊处于劣势，这让球队几乎没有犯错的空间。
“（我对）缺乏控球感到失望，”Dylan Cease表示。“如果你没有球速或犀利的球路，但能投进好球区并执行到位，你依然能制造出局。但满场保送且完全没有控球绝对不是一个好配方。”
周五的表现与Dylan Cease本赛季大部分时间的表现形成了鲜明对比。在符合投球局数的美联投手之中，Dylan Cease在赛前以35.3%的三振率、239次三振、2.47的FIP以及.180的对手打击率排名第一，同时以2.40的自责分率排名第二。
然而，他的直球球速已经成为一个值得关注的问题。自6月份首次出现球速下滑的趋势在周五延续了下来，他的直球平均时速为93.6英里，而他本赛季的平均球速为96.9英里。他在周日的平均球速为94.8英里，9月7日则是94.9英里。
事实上，在周五的比赛中，Dylan Cease所有五种球路的球速都下降了至少2英里。
Dylan Cease在当晚倒数第二球时确实投出了95.5英里的最高球速，但他和捕手Alejandro Kirk都认为，球速读数的下降并没有从根本上改变他们应对打者的方式。
“我只是努力进入好球区并执行战术，”Dylan Cease说道。“你知道的，不管是92还是98英里，这项运动的核心就是投出执行到位的球。所以这正是我一直在努力做的事情。”
“我们并没有过分关注球速，”Alejandro Kirk用西班牙语补充道。“有时你虽然没有达到最佳状态，但依然可以制造很多出局数。对他的控球来说这是艰难的一晚，但他是一位极具统治力的投手。”
显而易见的问题是，特别是在赛季如此深入的阶段，球速下降是否与健康有关，以及这是否会导致多伦多蓝鸟给Dylan Cease安排额外的休息，或者跳过一次轮值。不过主教练John Schneider表示，目前没有任何迹象表明在球队全力冲刺季后赛席位时有必要做出这样的调整。
“对于一个投了这么长时间的球员，在与他进行沟通后，我们对医疗团队有着极大的信心和信任，”John Schneider说道。“如果出现真正的危险信号，让球员置身于受伤的风险中，那将是另一回事。他当然在苦苦支撑，而且对球路的效果感到沮丧。但我认为如果真的存在任何巨大、巨大的危险信号，他根本就不会站上投手丘。”
相反，John Schneider认为Dylan Cease寻找习惯球威的过程，可能导致了周五出现的控球问题。
“像他这样的投手……你已经习惯了用某种特定方式投球，”John Schneider说道。“他现在试图调动更多力量，但目前并没有取得（想要的结果）。然后你的投球动作就会稍微走样。他的球路配搭不如以往，而保送实在是太不符合他的一贯风格了。”
多伦多蓝鸟经不起Dylan Cease频繁的短局数投球。伤病迫使多伦多蓝鸟在整个赛季中多次采用牛棚车轮战和长中继投球，球队也利用轮空日采取四人轮值，以便让Dylan Cease和José Soriano尽可能多地登板投球。
多伦多蓝鸟最终在周五使用了六名投手才吃完八局。
“在我看来，这是最好的牛棚之一，但我们也需要在打击和防守上提供支援，”在多伦多蓝鸟仅敲出5支安打并出现3次失误后，Alejandro Kirk说道。“我们不能把一切都压在投手身上。我们需要做好自己的工作，我们对此心知肚明。”

items.titleEn: Postseason hopes on the line in Blue Jays-Rangers showdown
bodyEn: ARLINGTON -- With just nine games left in the regular season, this weekend’s series between the Rangers (76-77) and Blue Jays (76-77) could swing both the American League West and Wild Card races.

Following the Rangers' loss to the Red Sox on Thursday night, Texas dropped one game back of Houston (77-76) in the AL West and remains two games back of the final AL Wild Card spot. The Blue Jays also sit two games back of the Guardians (78-75) for the final spot.
Texas already holds the tiebreaker over Toronto after a four-game sweep at Rogers Centre from June 25-28, so this series won’t affect that.

“That's what's so much fun about coming to the ballpark,” Rangers manager Skip Schumaker said. “You're just locked in on all these games. I just love this time of year in general. I think for the fans it's a fun time to come to the ballpark, because so much is on the line. Every game is huge. ... I'm very blessed that we're part of that [playoff] conversation. Again, that's why it makes it fun to come to the yard.”

For the Blue Jays, it’s Wild Card or bust. This season has been a disappointment in so many ways coming off last year’s run to Game 7 of the World Series, but the door is still cracked open for them to sneak into the dance.

“We have work to do,” said Max Scherzer, one of the Blue Jays’ emotional leaders and a former Rangers pitcher. “It takes all of us, not only the starting staff, but the bullpen, the hitters. We have to win ballgames. Our backs are against the wall. We’ve got to come out fighting and clawing, and keep finding ways to win ballgames.”
Let’s dive in:
The postseason picture: What’s at stake?

Blue Jays: Everything. Fresh off a series loss to the Tigers, the Blue Jays have left themselves with an uphill climb and do not hold the tiebreaker against the White Sox, so they’d need to clear them. With the Rangers and Orioles on the schedule for this road trip before their season finale against the Reds back at home, they’re running out of time. Missing the postseason would be a complete and total failure for Toronto, which entered 2026 with World Series expectations.

Rangers: The Rangers don’t control their own destiny. The only thing they can control is winning as many games as possible to put themselves in the best position to get to the postseason. This series -- and every game before and after it -- means just about everything. Even though Texas can't win the tiebreaker over Toronto, the Rangers need to keep winning to maintain their position in both the AL West and the AL Wild Card races.
What has been an area of strength for each team down the stretch?

Blue Jays: The bullpen has been spectacular, but how much further can that group be pushed? At times, the Blue Jays have been forced to roll out multiple bullpen games per week as this rotation struggles to get healthy. And while the potential return of Trey Yesavage on Sunday or Monday will help, the Blue Jays have asked so much from this bullpen. They’ve answered the call admirably, but how much is left in the tank?
Rangers: Home cooking. They have figured out how to win at home. Luckily for them, nine of their last 12 games have been at Globe Life Field.

Texas is 42-33 (.560) at Globe Life Field this season, has the fourth-best home record in the AL and the 10th-best home mark in MLB. The Rangers are 25-16 (.610) in their last 41 games at home dating back to June 19, going 10-2-1 in series play during the span, including an undefeated mark in all eight of their home sets since July 24.

“We've been playing really well at home, so that’s huge,” Schumaker said. “The guys are excited to come home and play some really good teams coming up. Like I said, that's the exciting part at this time of year. You have their meaningful games against a team that is trying to also win to get in. That's why this makes it fun.”
What are some of the weaknesses that could make each team vulnerable in the final stretch?

Blue Jays: This is still the second-lowest scoring offense in baseball, ahead of only the Angels. The Blue Jays’ bats had some flashes recently, but they’ll need to avoid the quiet nights completely if they want to go on a run. Vladimir Guerrero Jr. continues to struggle, and none of his big moments -- like his first 2026 home run at Rogers Centre on Sunday -- have snowballed into anything bigger. This offense needs to magically find another gear beginning in Game 154, which feels like an awfully big ask.

Rangers: They’re still not totally healthy. The Rangers had the full lineup back healthy for approximately an hour and a half last week, when Josh Jung and Nathan Eovaldi were activated from the injured list, but Joc Pederson was hit by a pitch on his left hand midway through that same game. Though Pederson has not been placed on the injured list, he does have a fracture in his hand and is hoping to continue playing through the pain for the remainder of the year.
Even if Pederson can play, he will clearly be limited, severely hurting the Rangers’ chances against right-handed pitching.
items.titleZh: 蓝鸟与游骑兵正面交锋，季后赛希望悬于一线
items.summaryZh: 常规赛仅剩九场，多伦多蓝鸟与得克萨斯游骑兵的系列赛将对美联西区及外卡争夺产生重大影响。
bodyZh: 阿灵顿讯 —— 随着常规赛仅剩九场比赛，游骑兵（76胜77负）与多伦多蓝鸟（76胜77负）本周末的系列赛可能会左右美国联盟西区以及外卡席位的争夺战。
在游骑兵周四晚输给波士顿红袜后，得克萨斯在美联西区落后休斯敦太空人（77胜76负）一场胜差，并且距离美联最后一张外卡席位依然有两场胜差。多伦多蓝鸟目前距离排名最后一张门票的克利夫兰守护者（78胜75负）也落后两场胜差。
由于游骑兵在6月25日至28日于罗杰斯中心进行的四连战中完成横扫，他们在对战成绩上已经占优，因此本系列赛不会改变这一对战优势。
“这就是来到球场最有趣的地方，”游骑兵主帅Skip Schumaker表示。“你全身心投入到所有这些比赛中。我总的来说非常喜欢每年的这个时候。我认为对于球迷来说，这也是来球场看球的好时机，因为有太多悬念系于一身。每一场比赛都至关重要……我非常庆幸我们能成为季后赛讨论的一部分。再说一次，这就是为什么来到球场会这么有趣。”
对多伦多蓝鸟而言，这已经是外卡席位之争的背水一战。继去年打进世界大赛第七场之后，本赛季多伦多在很多方面都令人失望，但他们杀入季后赛的大门依然留着一丝缝隙。
“我们还有工作要做，”多伦多蓝鸟的精神领袖之一、前游骑兵投手Max Scherzer表示。“这需要我们所有人的努力，不仅是先发投手，还有牛棚和打者。我们必须赢下比赛。我们已经退无可退。我们必须全力以赴、奋力拼搏，并不断寻找赢球的方法。”
让我们深入探讨：
季后赛格局：悬念何在？
多伦多蓝鸟：一切。刚刚在对阵底特律老虎的系列赛中失利后，多伦多蓝鸟发现自己面临着一条艰难的爬坡之路，且他们在与芝加哥白玉（原文White Sox）的对战中不占优势，因此他们必须超越对手。随着客场之旅将迎战游骑兵和巴尔的摩金莺，随后回到主场进行对阵辛辛那提红人的赛季收官战，他们的时间已经不多了。对于带着世界大赛期望进入2026赛季的多伦多而言，无缘季后赛将是一场彻底的失败。
得克萨斯游骑兵：游骑兵无法完全掌控自己的命运。他们唯一能掌控的就是尽可能多地赢得比赛，让自己处于晋级季后赛的最佳位置。这个系列赛——以及之前和之后的每一场比赛——几乎意味着一切。尽管得克萨斯无法在对战成绩上反超多伦多，但游骑兵必须继续赢球，才能保持他们在美联西区和美联外卡争夺战中的位置。
在冲刺阶段，各支球队的优势是什么？
多伦多蓝鸟：牛棚表现极其出色，但这个群体还能被推到什么极限？由于先发投手轮换难以保持健康，多伦多有时被迫在一周内多次打出牛棚车轮战。虽然Trey Yesavage在周日或周一潜在的回归会有所帮助，但多伦多向这个牛棚索取了太多。他们出色地完成了任务，但油箱里还剩多少油？
得克萨斯游骑兵：主场优势。他们已经找到了在主场赢球的方法。对他们而言幸运的是，他们最后12场比赛中有9场是在全球人寿球场（Globe Life Field）进行。
得克萨斯本赛季在全球人寿球场取得42胜33负（.560）的战绩，拥有美联第四好的主场战绩以及大联盟第十好的主场表现。自6月19日以来，游骑兵最近41场主场比赛取得25胜16负（.610），在此期间的系列赛中取得10胜2负1平，并且自7月24日以来在全部八个主场系列赛中保持不败。
“我们在主场打得非常好，这非常关键，”Schumaker说。“队员们很高兴回到主场，迎战接下来一些非常优秀的球队。就像我说的，这就是一年中这个时候最让人兴奋的部分。你要与一支同样在争取赢球晋级的球队进行意义重大的比赛。这就是为什么这很有趣。”
在最后的冲刺阶段，哪些弱点可能让各支球队不堪一击？
多伦多蓝鸟：这依然是大联盟得分倒数第二低的进攻火力，仅领先洛杉矶天使。多伦多蓝鸟的打线最近有过一些闪光点，但如果他们想要打出一波连胜，就必须彻底避免沉寂的夜晚。Vladimir Guerrero Jr.的状态仍在挣扎，他本周日的本垒打等高光时刻并未转化为任何更大的成果。这支进攻端需要在第154场比赛开始时神奇地找到另一个档位，这听起来像是一个极其苛刻的要求。
得克萨斯游骑兵：他们仍然没有完全恢复健康。上周Josh Jung和Nathan Eovaldi从伤病名单中激活时，游骑兵曾经拥有过大约一个半小时的全主力健康阵容，但在同一场比赛的中段，Joc Pederson的左手不幸被触身球击中。尽管Pederson尚未被放入伤病名单，但他的手部确实出现了骨折，并希望在今年剩余的时间里带着疼痛继续坚持比赛。
即使Pederson能够出战场上，他的发挥显然也会受到限制，这严重损害了游骑兵面对右投手时的胜算。

items.titleEn: Giddy up! Blue Jays rookies dress the part for trip down south
bodyEn: The Blue Jays are heading down south for a massive series this weekend against the Rangers, with postseason implications aplenty. Toronto rookies certainly dressed for the occasion.

The Blue Jays’ first-year players -- including Brett Bateman, Charles McAdoo, Sean Keys, Kazuma Okamoto and Trey Yesavage -- all donned cowboy hats, plaid sleeveless shirts, cutoff jeans and cowboy boots. One fan even received a signed ear of corn.
The idea for this particular theme for the traditional rookie road trip came from 42-year-old Max Scherzer, according to Toronto veteran Myles Straw.

“He was excited to show me a couple of days ago, and I thought it would be great, especially for a couple of the guys we’ve got in the rookie class,” Straw said. “Hopefully, there are some pictures. I’m sure there will be some pictures posted and [the media] will probably like it.”
The Blue Jays' series with the Rangers begins Friday at Globe Life Field.
items.titleZh: 蓝鸟菜鸟盛装打扮迎客
items.summaryZh: 多伦多蓝鸟新秀换上牛仔装扮开启客场之旅。
bodyZh: 多伦多蓝鸟本周末将前往南方与得克萨斯游骑兵进行一系列关键比赛，这场系列赛对季后赛形势影响重大。多伦多新秀们为此精心打扮了一番。
多伦多蓝鸟的年轻球员们——包括Brett Bateman、Charles McAdoo、Sean Keys、Kazuma Okamoto和Trey Yesavage——全都戴上了牛仔帽，穿上了格子无袖衬衫、剪边牛仔裤和牛仔靴。甚至还有一位球迷收到了一根签过名的玉米。
据多伦多老将Myles Straw透露，这次传统菜鸟客场之旅的主题创意来自于42岁的Max Scherzer。
Straw表示：“他几天前兴奋地把这个想法展示给我看，我觉得这太棒了，特别是对于我们这批新秀来说。希望会有一些照片留念。我确信会有照片发出来，而且大家大概也会喜欢。”
多伦多蓝鸟与得克萨斯游骑兵的系列赛将于周五在环球人寿球场开打。

items.titleEn: Here are the breakout prospects of the year -- one for each team
bodyEn: We live for breakouts here at MLB Pipeline. They’re proof of many things in baseball. For example, players aren’t robots and can improve their standing in the game, and when we say player development isn’t linear, it also means that unforeseen leaps in value are included. The sport’s beauty is in its unpredictability, especially its unforeseen good outcomes.

Below, we’ve selected the breakout prospect of the year from each of the 30 farm systems. It could be someone who jumped from outside the Top 30 to a firm spot within those rankings, or it could be a previously ranked prospect who emerged even more into prominence. In fact, eight current Top 100 prospects are included here. General preference was given to prospects who were in the organization for the entire 2026 season, but in some cases, the best breakout talents were acquired in trades and kept on rolling in their new organizations.
Jump to: AL East | AL Central | AL West | NL East | NL Central | NL West
AMERICAN LEAGUE EAST

Blue Jays: Nolan Perry, RHP (No. 2/MLB No. 94)The 2022 12th-rounder missed the entire 2025 season due to Tommy John surgery and didn’t crack the Jays’ preseason Top 30 list as a result. He looked revitalized after rehab, however, and finished with a 2.50 ERA, 1.02 WHIP and 117 strikeouts over 82 2/3 innings across the Single-A, High-A and Double-A levels, and he jumped into the Top 100 when it became clearer that he had the stuff to back up the results: a 93-95 mph heater with improved velo, two whiff-inducing breakers in a slider and a curveball and an improved offspeed option in his mid-80s splitter.

Orioles: Caden Hunter, LHP (No. 4/MLB No. 96)The Orioles’ sixth-round pick out of Southern Cal in the 2025 Draft, Hunter wasn’t even on the team’s Top 30 list at the start of the season. But he quickly showed that an assignment to Single-A Delmarva was no challenge and he earned not one, but two promotions and he finished the year leading all Minor League pitchers who reached 100 innings pitched with his 13.19 K/9 rate and 36.4 K percentage, while placing second in batting average against (.170) and third in K-BB% (25.1 pct).

Rays: Cooper Flemming, INF (No. 5/MLB No. 82)Even though he was Tampa Bay’s second-round pick last year, Flemming slotted in at No. 28 on the Rays’ preseason Top 30 because of the depth of the organization's farm. But it didn’t take long for him to look like perhaps the most gifted hitter at Single-A Charleston, and indeed, he was named the Carolina League MVP this week having hit .298/.379/.450 with 11 homers, 16 steals and a 126 wRC+ over 116 games with the RiverDogs. Flemming ran a solid contact rate for his first full season, and there should be more power to come in his 6-foot-3 frame as he enters his 20s.

Red Sox: Franklin Primera, C/1B (No. 4)Signed for just $10,000 out of Venezuela in 2024, Primera made a spectacular U.S. debut two years later, slashing .427/.549/.718 in the Rookie-level Florida Complex League and .329/.466/.494 in Single-A at age 19. Not only did he total 13 homers in 78 games, but he also displayed all the tools to become a solid defender behind the plate.

Yankees: Wilberson De Pena, OF (No. 14)Acquired from the Angels for Oswald Peraza at the 2025 Trade Deadline, De Pena earned MVP and top prospect honors in the Florida Complex League this summer after winning the triple crown (.358-16-67) and also leading the Rookie-level circuit in slugging (.677), OPS (1.088), hits (81), doubles (20), extra-base hits (38) and total bases (153). Though he struggled following a promotion to Single-A at age 19, he still showed well-above-average raw power and flashed plus speed.
AMERICAN LEAGUE CENTRAL

Guardians: Juneiker Caceres, OF (No. 4/MLB No. 81)In his first extended taste of full-season ball at age 18, Caceres batted .301/.409/.484 with 11 homers in 74 games between two Class A levels despite dealing with an oblique injury. His knack for making consistent hard contact has allowed him to emerge as the best prospect from the Guardians' 2024 international class, even if his $300,000 bonus ranked just eighth-highest in that crop.

Royals: Justin Lamkin, LHP (No. 8)Lamkin showed signs that a breakout was coming in his first Spring Training, and he carried that into the season by moving past High-A Quad Cities after only six starts and striking out 15 over 11 1/3 innings in his first two Double-A starts. His regular season ended there with a shoulder strain, but he’d shown enough when healthy to become Kansas City’s third-ranked pitching prospect. He’s slated to appear in the Arizona Fall League, and his 91-94 mph fastball and 80-83 mph slider (the latter of which had a 55 percent whiff rate in ‘26, per Synergy) along with his above-average control will gain a bigger audience.

Tigers: Brett Callahan, OF (No. 17)Callahan hadn’t played more than 71 games or seen a level above High-A in any of his first three Minor League seasons, but the Tigers believed there was enough with his speed, defense and power potential for a breakout to come in his age-24 season. Indeed, it did as he hit .269/.365/.443 over 96 games at Double-A and Triple-A and set new career bests for homers (13) and steals (29). The former St. Joseph’s star debuted in the Majors on Aug. 16 and has seen time mostly in left field so far in the bigs.

Twins: Khadim Diaw, C/OF (No. 9)Diaw has always hit well when he’s been on the field, but he missed a bunch of time with a broken thumb in his Draft season at Loyola Marymount before landing in the third round of the 2024 Draft, then managed just 39 games with a broken wrist and then a hamstring issue. He topped 100 games this year, making it to Double-A, and the results came, as he hit .306/.417/.452 and led the organization with his 130 wRC+, rising from No. 23 up into the top 10 as a result while splitting time between catcher and center field.

White Sox: Anthony DePino, 1B (No. 22)Though DePino set Rhode Island single-season and career marks for runs, homers, extra-base hits, total bases and walks in 2025, when he also was just one of two NCAA Division I players to total 20 homers and 20 steals, teams didn't love his age (22) or his profile as a righty-hitting first baseman. His power, penchant for hard contact and mental toughness led the White Sox to take him in the seventh round and translated into a .262/.363/.481 first full pro season with 25 homers in 125 games between High-A and Double-A.
AMERICAN LEAGUE WEST

Angels: Hayden Alvarez, OF (No. 3)The Angels don’t hesitate to challenge players with aggressive promotions, so it wasn’t surprising to see them move Alvarez as a teenager from Single-A to High-A this year after he posted an OPS of .875 at the lower level. He held his own with High-A Tri-City and finished with a combined .289/.391/.456 slash line, answering some questions about impact with 49 extra-base hits and 12 homers to go along with 53 steals. He was third in the system among qualified prospects in wRC+ (118), jumping from No. 12 on the Halos’ list to his current standing and entering Top 100 conversations.

Astros: Jason Schiavone, C/1B (No. 6)An 11th-round pick out of James Madison in 2024, Schiavone rarely chases pitches and produces elite exit velocities but also swings and misses at alarming levels against all types of pitches inside and outside the strike zone. That combination will produce the first 30-30 season by a Minor League catcher since Willie Royster in 1981 if he can swipe one more bag during the final week of the Triple-A season. He has hit .246/.386/.521 with 31 homers and 29 steals in 118 games while advancing from High-A to Triple-A.

A’s: Breyson Guedez, OF (No. 9)There is a tendency to try to not get too excited about a strong DSL performance since it’s typically a very hitter-friendly league, but the A’s were excited to see what Guedez would do when he came stateside this year for the first time after signing for $1.5 million in January of 2025, then hitting .359 with an .885 OPS at age 17 in the Dominican. He still needs to work on his approach (132/28 K/BB) but it’s looking like he’s no flash in the plan. He skipped over the ACL and hit his way from Single-A Stockton to High-A Lansing as an 18-year old, jumping from No. 23 at the start of the season into the organization’s top 10.

Mariners: Boston Smith, C/OF (No. 13)Smith began Spring Training with the team that drafted him in 2025’s sixth round, the Nationals, but was sent to the White Sox before the year officially started. He had mashed his way to Double-A by the time the Mariners got him at the Trade Deadline in the Luis Castillo deal. He wasn’t on the White Sox Top 30 to start the season, but was in the middle of that list and had hit 22 homers over 79 games when he was dealt. He added nine more to be one of 22 hitters with more than 30 homers this season and he also finished in the top 20 in all of the Minors with 97 walks. His 158 combined wRC+ was fourth among all hitters.

Rangers: Hector Osorio, OF (No. 14)Signed for $47,500 out of Venezuela in 2022, Osorio spent three years in Rookie ball before making his full-season debut in 2025 and starring in 2026. His best attributes are his bat-to-ball skills and high baseball IQ, which helped him slash .295/.411/.543 with 21 homers and more walks (54) than strikeouts (50) in 87 games between two Class A levels. He didn't play after mid-July because of back issues.
NATIONAL LEAGUE EAST

Braves: Eric Hartman, OF (No. 1/MLB No. 41)A 20th-round pick out of the Canadian high school ranks in 2024, Hartman showed enough glimpses in his first full season of pro ball to land at No. 21 on the Braves’ list to start the year, but nothing could have prepared us for this. Sure, the jump to Double-A was a struggle, but he’s only 20 and he earned the promotion after hitting 24 homers and swiping 38 bags in 94 games with High-A Rome. He finished the year with 26 home runs and 56 steals.

Marlins: Brandon Compton, OF (No. 13)A power outage during his redshirt sophomore season at Arizona State dropped Compton to the second round of the 2025 Draft, but he had no such issues during his first full pro season. He has batted .273/.414/.580 with 35 home runs in 121 games from High-A to Triple-A, ranking fifth in the Minors in OPS (.994), seventh in homers and eighth in slugging.

Mets: Émilien Pitre, 2B (No. 10)The 2024 second-rounder was squeezed out of the Rays’ Top 30 by Tampa Bay’s famed prospect depth but was showing off a strong hit tool at High-A and Double-A before he was moved to the Mets as part of the Freddy Peralta return. Now up with Triple-A Syracuse, he owns a .306/.420/.427 line with six homers and 35 steals in 118 games across the top three levels of the Minors, but what might pop up most is that he’s walked 80 times and struck out only 57 in that span. His 1.4 BB/K ratio is second-best among 729 MiLB full-season qualifiers.

Nationals: Ronny Cruz, INF (No. 7)It was certainly a roller-coaster season for the infielder, his first with the Nationals after being acquired from the Cubs for Michael Soroka last year, but like player development, breakouts aren’t always linear either. Cruz was the talk of the backfields at Nationals camp in the spring and backed up the chatter by hitting .333/.460/.627 with three homers in 14 games at Single-A Fredericksburg, prompting a quick move up to High-A. His aggressive nature caught up to him early with Wilmington, but he heated up again late with a .511 slugging percentage and just a 16.7 percent K rate over his final 24 games. Entering his age-20 season, Cruz still has Top 100 potential with his power-speed combination, and after being ranked No. 25 to start his age-19 season, he’s trending back toward prominence in an emerging Nats system.

Phillies: Bryan Rincon, SS (No. 4/MLB No. 100)The feeling was that if Rincon, the Phillies’ 14th-round flier in the 2022 Draft, hit at all, he’d have a chance because his plus defense at shortstop gave him a very high floor. Until this year, he hadn’t shown he could, and he hadn’t stayed healthy. This year, things really started to click in Double-A, and it’s not just because Reading is a nice place to hit. The 22-year-old led the Eastern League with his .927 OPS and 95 walks, while tying for the league lead with 26 homers. He also swiped 30 bags and kept his strikeouts in check even with the power surge.
NATIONAL LEAGUE CENTRAL

Brewers: Ricki Moneys, SS (No. 15)Milwaukee has been the gold standard for international scouting and development in recent years. Moneys signed for the third-most money among this year’s Brewers class at $1.15 million but surged into prominence with easy power that has played quickly in the pros. He hit .289/.440/.479 with five homers, 28 steals and a 45/46 K/BB ratio over 53 games in the Dominican Summer League, and while DSL stats can be deceiving, his data was just as strong to make him look like a future everyday bat in the Majors.

Cardinals: Alexander Frias, OF (No. 4)Frias was showing off impressive exit velocities and elite bat speed from the left side as he climbed from the Arizona Complex League to Single-A Wilson in the Brewers system when Milwaukee moved him to the Cardinals (along with fellow breakout talent Josiah Ragsdale) in the Deadline deal for Dustin May and JoJo Romero. The 18-year-old outfielder is now in Top 100 discussions because of his raw skills and true projection, but for all that talk of the future, he also hit .314/.405/.500 with 10 homers, 25 steals and a 130 wRC+ over 86 games in his first stateside season.

Cubs: Josiah Hartshorn, 1B/OF, (No. 1/MLB No. 38)The Cubs obviously valued Hartshorn when they gave him a sixth-round-record $2 million bonus a year ago, but they never expected that he'd finish his pro debut as a 19-year-old in Double-A. The California prep product makes unusually advanced swing decisions and features more power than most players his age, leading to a .284/.407/.518 line with 23 homers and 17 steals in 125 games from Single-A to Double-A.

Pirates: Murf Gray, 3B (No. 4/MLB No. 93)Because he didn’t play at all after signing and also so he could work on some swing decision issues, particularly a penchant for swinging at everything (because he makes contact with everything), Gray began the year with Single-A Bradenton. But that didn’t last long and he proved to be one of the best power hitters in the game, mashing 32 homers and finishing the year in Double-A. He still chased at a 30-percent rate, but upped his walk rate considerably compared to his final year at Fresno State, making a lot of people believe it’s going to work in the big leagues.

Reds: Jirvin Morillo, C (No. 9)After signing for $420,000 in January 2024, Morillo spent two summers in the DSL before coming to the U.S. The switch-hitter played all of 2026 at age 19, and hit his way out of the Arizona Complex League to full-season ball and finished with a combined .303/.433/.580 line in 76 total games. His 139 wRC+ is fourth among all Reds’ farmhands with at least 250 plate appearances, and it’s his offensive potential that catapulted him from No. 24 on the preseason Top 30 up into the top 10 for the organization.
NATIONAL LEAGUE WEST

D-backs: Carlos Virahonda, C (No. 5)Virahonda was the breakout pick last year too when he first leapt onto Arizona’s Top 30 for the first time, and he’s taken another leap off that foundation and into the Top 5 with his best offensive showing yet in 2026. The backstop, who still earns his best grades for his defensive work, clubbed 19 homers across Single-A, High-A and Double-A – almost five times his previous career best – and finished with a .272/.377/.493 line and 122 wRC+ in 102 games. He’ll compete with fellow Top 30 prospects Ryder Helfrick, Alberto Barriga and Ivan Luciano to be the D-backs’ catcher of the future.

Dodgers: Chase Harlan, 3B (No. 9)Harlan did a better job of tapping into his big raw power in 2026 by improving his selectivity and making more contact. A 2024 third-rounder from a Pennsylvania high school who signed for a well over-slot $1,747,500, he batted .298/.403/.509 with 14 homers in 86 games between two Class A levels despite missing the final six weeks with an oblique injury.

Giants: Jonah Cox, OF (graduated from Giants Top 30)Picked up from the Athletics in a February 2024 trade for Ross Stripling, Cox batted .261/.352/.386 in his first two seasons in the Giants system. After making adjustments to his right-handed swing and becoming more selective, he exploded for a .415/.468/.647 line with 34 steals in 55 games between Double-A and Triple-A. The son of former big league catcher Darron Cox, he has spent most of the last three-plus months as a semi-regular in San Francisco.

Padres: Bryan Balzer, RHP (No. 6)Balzer’s first full season was a rocky one in 2025 with a 7.92 ERA and a 1.78 WHIP over 50 innings with Single-A Lake Elsinore. Not only did he expand the workload by almost double with 98 2/3 frames at Single-A and High-A, but better results also followed with a 4.74 ERA, 1.39 WHIP and 100 strikeouts over that time. The 6-foot-1 right-hander can work into the triple digits and shows a pair of fastballs typically sitting closer to the mid-90s. His mid-80s sweeper earns the best reviews, and he’ll throw a splitter and cutter too for different looks.

Rockies: Cristian Arguelles, OF (No. 5)After signing for $700,000 in January of 2024, the Rockies gave Arguelles two tours in the Dominican Summer League before he came stateside. In his second summer, he won the DSL batting title (.422) and MVP honors, then showed he wasn’t a DSL-enhanced hitter by topping the ACL with a .402 average and earning a bump to full-season Fresno. He finished with a combined .971 OPS, with 44 extra-base hits (23 doubles, 10 triples, 11 homers), 92 RBIs and 15 steals over 92 games. He also walked (11.0 percent) nearly as much as he struck out (12.0) and posted an impressive 137 wRC+ for the year.
items.titleZh: 各队年度潜力大爆发新秀
items.summaryZh: 本文盘点了MLB各支球队系统在2026赛季中实现大爆发的潜力新秀。球员们的表现证明了棒球发展并非一成不变，充满了无限可能。
bodyZh: 我们MLB Pipeline网站的工作动力就来自于新秀的大爆发。它们是棒球场上许多事情的证明。例如，球员并非机器人，他们可以在比赛中提升自己的地位；而当我们说球员的发展并非线性时，这也意味着价值上会出现意想不到的飞跃。这项运动的美妙之处在于其不可预测性，尤其是那些意料之外的良好结果。
在下文中，我们从全部30支球队的农场系统中选出了各自的年度爆发新秀。他们可能是从30名开外一跃进入这些排名榜单的黑马，也可能是此前已有排名但表现更加突出的新星。事实上，目前有8位百大新秀入选了这里。我们的总体偏好是那些在整个2026赛季都效力于该组织的球员，但在某些情况下，最优秀的爆发型人才是通过交易获得的，并在新球队中延续了出色的表现。
跳转至：美联东区 | 美联中区 | 美联西区 | 国联东区 | 国联中区 | 国联西区
美国联盟东区

多伦多蓝鸟：Nolan Perry，右投手（第2名/大联盟第94名）这位2022年第12轮选秀新秀因进行托马斯·约翰（Tommy John）手术而缺席了整个2025赛季，因此未能入选蓝鸟队季前的Top 30名单。然而，他在康复后展现出焕然一新的状态，在单A、高阶单A和双A级别的总共82.2局投球中，交出了2.50的自责分率、1.02的WHIP以及117次三振。随着其实力足以支撑这些数据变得更加明朗，他一跃进入了百大新秀行列：球速提升至93-95英里/小时的直球、两种能制造挥空的球种（滑球和曲球），以及改进后、时速在85英里/小时左右的指叉球。

巴尔的摩金莺：Caden Hunter，左投手（第4名/大联盟第96名）作为金莺队在2025年选秀大会从南加州大学选中的第六轮新秀，Hunter在赛季开始时甚至没有进入球队的Top 30名单。但他很快证明，被指派到单A的德尔马瓦对镇毫无挑战，并为自己赢得了不止一次、而是两次晋升。在所有投满100局的小联盟投手，他以13.19的每九局三振率（K/9）和36.4%的三振率（K%）领跑全小联盟，同时在被打击率（.170）上排名第二，在三振保送率差（K-BB%为25.1%）上排名第三。

坦帕湾光芒：Cooper Flemming，内野手（第5名/大联盟第82名）尽管他是光芒去年第二轮选秀的新秀，但由于该组织农场深度雄厚，Flemming在光芒队季前Top 30中仅排在第28位。但没过多久，他就展现出查尔斯顿单A队中最具天赋打者的潜质，本周他确实被评为卡罗莱纳联盟MVP。在效力于河狗队（RiverDogs）的116场比赛中，他交出了.298/.379/.450的打击三围，伴有11支本垒打、16次盗垒以及126的wRC+。在他的首个完整赛季中，Flemming展现了稳健的击球率，随着他迈入20岁，其6尺3寸的身材有望释放更多长打火力。

波士顿红袜：Franklin Primera，捕手/一垒手（第4名）2024年从委内瑞拉以仅10,000美元签约，Primera在两年后迎来了惊艳的美国赛场首秀。在新人联盟佛罗里达综合联盟（Florida Complex League）中，他打出了.427/.549/.718的打击三围，而在19岁时升至单A的成绩则为.329/.466/.494。在78场比赛中，他不仅轰出了13支本垒打，还展现了成为本垒后方稳健防守者的各项全能技术。

纽约洋基：Wilberson De Pena，外野手（第14名）在2025年交易截止日从天使队交易换取Oswald Peraza后，De Pena今年夏天在佛罗里达综合联盟赢得了MVP和顶级新秀荣誉。他不仅斩获三冠王（.358打击率、16支本垒打、67打点），还在这支新人联盟中领跑长长打率（.677）、OPS（1.088）、安打数（81）、二垒安打（20）、长打数（38）和总垒打数（153）。尽管19岁升入单A后一度遭遇挣扎，但他依然展现出远高于平均水平的纯粹长打能力和出色的速度。
美国联盟中区
克利夫兰守护者：Juneiker Caceres，外野手（第4名/大联盟第81名）在18岁迎来首个完整的全赛季历练时，Caceres克服了斜肌伤势的影响，在两个A级联赛的74场比赛中交出了.301/.409/.484的打击三围外加11支本垒打。他持续制造扎实击球的诀窍使他脱颖而出，成为守护者队2024届国际球员签约中最优秀的新秀，尽管他30万美元的签约金在该届新秀中仅排在第八位。

堪萨斯城皇家：Justin Lamkin，左投手（第8名）Lamkin在春训中就展现出爆发的迹象，并将这种状态延续到了常规赛中。他在仅完成6次先发后便跳级升至高阶单A双城四市（Quad Cities），并在前两次双A先发中于11.1局内送出15次三振。他的常规赛因肩膀拉伤而提前结束，但在健康时展现出的实力已足够让他成为堪萨斯城排名第三的投手新秀。他预计将参加亚利桑那秋季联赛，其91-94英里/小时的直球和80-83英里/小时的滑球（根据Synergy数据，后者在2026年的挥空率高达55%），再加上高于平均水平的控球，将吸引更多人的关注。

底特律老虎：Brett Callahan，外野手（第17名）在其前三个小联盟赛季中，Callahan从未在任何一年出场超过71场，也未曾踏足高于高阶单A的层级。但老虎队坚信，凭借他的速度、防守和长打潜力，他在24岁这个赛季有望迎来爆发。事实也的确如此，他在双A和三亚的96场比赛中打出.269/.365/.443的成绩，并刷新了单季本垒打（13）和盗垒（29）的个人职业生涯最佳纪录。这位前圣约瑟夫大学的明星于8月16日完成大联盟首秀，在大联盟中目前主要镇守左外野。

明尼苏达双城：Khadim Diaw，捕手/外野手（第9名）Diaw在球场上时一直有着出色的打击表现，但在他效力洛约拉马利蒙特大学（Loyola Marymount）的选秀年，他因右手拇指骨折错失了大量比赛，随后在第三轮被选中。紧接着他又遭遇手腕骨折和腿筋问题，仅打了39场比赛。今年他的出场数突破100场并升至双A，数据也随之爆发：他交出了.306/.417/.452的打击三围，以130的wRC+领跑整个组织，同时在捕手和中外野之间分担守备任务，排名从第23位一跃升入前十。

芝加哥白袜：Anthony DePino，一垒手（第22名）尽管DePino在2025年打破了罗德岛大学的单赛季和生涯得分、本垒打、长打、总垒打数以及保送纪录（当年他也是NCAA第一级别仅有的两位达成20支本垒打和20次盗垒的球员之一），但各支球队并不太看好他的年龄（22岁）以及作为右打一垒手的定位。他出色的力量、对扎实击球的偏好以及顽强的心理素质，促使白袜队在第七轮选中了他，而这也转化为他在职业生涯首个完整赛季中，在高效单A和双A出战125场比赛中交出的.262/.363/.481打击三围以及25支本垒打。
美国联盟西区

洛杉矶天使：Hayden Alvarez，外野手（第3名）天使队向来毫不犹豫地通过激进的晋升来考验球员，因此看到他们在Alvarez于低阶单A打出.875的OPS后，在今年将这位青少年球员从单A直接提拔到高阶单A，也并不令人意外。他在高阶单A三城（Tri-City）站稳了脚跟，最终交出了.289/.391/.456的综合打击三围，用49支长打、12支本垒打以及53次盗垒回应了关于其实力的质疑。他在该系统符合资格的新秀中wRC+排名第三（118），从天使队名单的第12位跃升至当前的地位，并开始进入百大新秀的讨论范围。

休斯敦太空人：Jason Schiavone，捕手/一垒手（第6名）作为2024年从詹姆斯麦迪逊大学选中的第11轮新秀，Schiavone很少追打坏球，并能制造出顶级的击球初速，但无论面对好球带内外的各种球路，他也会产生惊人的挥空率。如果他能在三亚赛季的最后一周再偷一个垒，他将复制自1981年Willie Royster以来小联盟捕手首个“30-30”（30轰30盗）赛季。在从高阶单A一路晋升至三亚的118场比赛中，他打出了.246/.386/.521的成绩，伴有31支本垒打和29次盗垒。

运动家：Breyson Guedez，外野手（第9名）人们往往倾向于对多米尼加夏季联赛（DSL）的出色表现不要过于兴奋，因为那通常是一个极度有利于打者的联盟。但在2025年1月以150万美元签约、并在多米尼加17岁时打出.359打击率和.885 OPS之后，运动家队非常期待Guedez今年首次来到美国本土后的表现。他仍然需要打磨自己的选球策略（132次三振/28次保送），但看起来他并非昙花一现。作为一名18岁的球员，他跳过了ACL（亚利桑那复杂联盟），一路从单A斯托克顿（Stockton）打到了高阶单A兰辛（Lansing），排名从赛季初的第23位跃升至该组织的前十名。

西拉图水手：Boston Smith，捕手/外野手（第13名）Smith在春训开始时效力于在2025年第六轮选中他的国民队，但在赛季正式开始前被送往白袜队。当水手队在交易截止日通过Luis Castillo的交易得到他时，他已经一路猛打升到了双A。在赛季开始时，他并未进入白袜队的Top 30，但在被交易时，他已经位居该名单的中游，并在79场比赛中轰出22支本垒打。他随后又添了9轰，成为本赛季全小联盟22名轰出30支以上本垒打的打者之一，同时以97次保送在整个小联盟中跻身前20名。他158的综合wRC+在所有打者中名列第四。

得克萨斯游骑兵：Hector Osorio，外野手（第14名）2022年从委内瑞拉以47,500美元签约，Osorio在新人联盟度过了三年，随后在2025年迎来全赛季首秀并在2026年大放异彩。他最突出的特质是精准的棒球接触技巧和极高的棒球智商，这帮助他在两个A级联赛的87场比赛中，交出了.295/.411/.543的打击三围，并有21支本垒打，同时保送数（54）多于三振数（50）。由于背部问题，他在7月中旬之后便未能出场。
国家联盟东区

亚特兰大勇士：Eric Hartman，外野手（第1场/大联盟第41名）作为2024年从加拿大高中梯队选中的第20轮新秀，Hartman在职业首个完整赛季中展现出足够的闪光点，赛季初在勇士队名单上排在第21位，但没有什么能让我们为接下来发生的一切做好准备。当然，直接升入双A充满挣扎，但他年仅20岁，在效力高阶单A罗马（Rome）的94场比赛中轰出24支本垒打并盗垒38次后，他赢得了这次晋升。他最终以26支本垒打和56次盗垒结束了这一年。
迈阿密马林鱼：Brandon Compton，外野手（第13名）亚利桑那州立大学红衫大二赛季的长打哑火让Compton在2025年选秀大会跌至第二轮，但在他的职业首个完整赛季中，他没有遇到此类问题。从高阶单A到三亚的121场比赛中，他打出了.273/.414/.580的打击三围和35支本垒打，在小联盟中OPS排名第五（.994），本垒打排名第七，长打率排名第八。

纽约大都会：Émilien Pitre，二垒手（第10名）这位2024年的第二轮选秀新秀由于坦帕湾著名的农场深度而被挤出了光芒队的Top 30，但在被作为Freddy Peralta交易的回报送往大都会队之前，他一直在高阶单A和双A展现出强劲的安打实力。目前他已升至三亚雪城（Syracuse），在小联盟最高三个级别的118场比赛中交出了.306/.420/.427的成绩，伴有6支本垒打和35次盗垒。最引人注目的可能是他在这一期间获得了80次保送，仅被三振57次。他的1.4的保送三振比（BB/K）在所有729名小联盟全赛季符合资格的球员中排名第二。

华盛顿国民：Ronny Cruz，内野手（第7名）对这位内野手而言，这无疑是一个过山车般的赛季。这是他去年从库比队交易换取Michael Soroka后效力国民队的第一个赛季，但正如球员发展一样，爆发也并非总是线性的。Cruz在春训国民队训练营的后场训练中引起了热议，并在单A弗雷德里克斯堡（Fredericksburg）的14场比赛中以.333/.460/.627的打击率和3支本垒打印证了这种说法，从而促使他迅速升入高阶单A。他在威尔明顿（Wilmington）初期遭遇了激进风格带来的挫折，但在最后24场比赛中再度回暖，交出了.511的长打率以及仅16.7%的三振率。随着迎来20岁赛季，Cruz凭借其力量与速度的结合依然具备百大新秀的潜力。在19岁赛季初排名第25位之后，他在这个正在崛起的国民系统中正朝着重回显赫地位的方向发展。

费城费城人：Bryan Rincon，游击手（第4名/大联盟第100名）人们普遍认为，如果费城人在2022年选秀第14轮淘到的宝藏Rincon能打出任何进攻表现，他就会有机会，因为他在游击位置上的出色防守为他奠定了极高的下限。直到今年之前，他还没能证明自己能做到这一点，也未能保持健康。今年，一切在双A真正开始步入正轨，这不仅仅是因为里丁（Reading）是个适合打击的好地方。这位22岁的球员以.927的OPS和95次保送领跑东部联盟（Eastern League），同时以26支本垒打并列联盟第一。在长打井喷的同时，他还完成了30次盗垒并控制住了三振数。
国家联盟中区

密尔沃基酿酒人：Ricki Moneys，游击手（第15名）近年来，密尔沃基一直是国际球探和球员发展的黄金标准。Moneys以115万美元的签约金成为今年酿酒人队内签约金额第三高的球员，并凭借轻松的长打火力迅速在职业赛场崭露头角。他在多米尼加夏季联赛的53场比赛中，交出了.289/.440/.479的打击三围，伴有5支本垒打、28次盗垒以及45/46的三振保送比。尽管DSL的数据可能具有欺骗性，但他的各项数据同样强劲，使其看起来具备成为大联盟未来日常打者的潜质。

圣路易斯红雀：Alexander Frias，外野手（第4名）当密尔沃基在关于Dustin May和JoJo Romero的截止日交易中将Frias（以及另一位爆发型才俊Josiah Ragsdale）交易给红雀队时，这位左打外野手正从亚利桑那综合联盟一路攀升至酿酒人系统的单A威尔逊（Wilson），期间展现出令人印象深刻的击球初速和顶级的挥棒速度。这位18岁的外野手凭借其原始技巧和真正的成长预期，目前已进入百大新秀的讨论范围，抛开对未来的种种讨论不谈，他在美国本土的首个赛季中，在86场比赛里便打出了.314/.405/.500的打击三围，伴有10支本垒打、25次盗垒和130的wRC+。

芝加哥小熊：Josiah Hartshorn，一垒手/外野手（第1场/大联盟第38名）一年前，小熊队以创纪录的第六轮200万美元签约金签下Hartshorn时，显然看重了他的价值，但他们绝没有想到他能以19岁之龄在双A结束自己的职业首秀。这位加州高中出品的球员做出了异常成熟的挥棒选择，并具备超越同龄大多数球员的长打火力，这使他在从单A到双A的125场比赛中交出了.284/.407/.518的成绩，并有23支本垒打和17次盗垒。

匹兹堡海盗：Murf Gray，三垒手（第4名/大联盟第93名）由于签约后完全没有出场比赛，加上需要解决一些挥棒选择上的问题（尤其是对所有球都出棒的倾向，因为他什么球都能打到），Gray在单A布雷登顿（Bradenton）开始了这一年。但这并未持续多久，他证明了自己是比赛中最出色的长打好手之一，轰出32支本垒打并在双A结束了这一赛季。虽然他依然有30%的追打坏球率，但相比于他在弗雷斯诺州立大学的最后一个赛季，他的保送率有了显著提升，这让许多人坚信他在大联盟中能够成功。

辛辛那提红人：Jirvin Morillo，捕手（第9名）在2024年1月以420,000美元签约后，Morillo在DSL度过了两个夏天，随后才来到美国。这位两栖打者在整个2026赛季年满19岁，他一路从亚利桑那综合联盟打拼至全赛季层级，在总共76场比赛中交出了.303/.433/.580的综合打击三围。他的139的wRC+在所有打席数至少达到250次的红人农场球员中排名第四，正是他的进攻潜力使他从季前Top 30的第24位一跃升入该组织的前十名。
国家联盟西区

亚利桑那响尾蛇：Carlos Virahonda，捕手（第5名）Virahonda在去年也是爆发新秀的代表，当时他首次入选亚利桑那的Top 30名单。凭借2026年迄今最佳的进攻表现，他在这一基础上再度飞跃，杀入前五。这位以防守端出色表现而获得最高评价的捕手，在单A、高阶单A和双A总共轰出了19支本垒打——几乎是其此前职业生涯最佳纪录的五倍——并在102场比赛中交出了.272/.377/.493的成绩单和122的wRC+。他将与同为Top 30新秀的Ryder Helfrick、Alberto Barriga以及Ivan Luciano竞争响尾蛇未来主力捕手的位置。
洛杉矶道奇：Chase Harlan，三垒手（第9名）Harlan在2026年通过改善选球和提升击球率，更好地展现了其出众的原始长打能力。作为一名2024年从宾夕法尼亚州高中选中的第三轮选秀新秀，他获得了远超顺位槽的1,747,500美元签约金。尽管因斜肌伤势缺席了最后六周的比赛，他仍在两个A级联赛的86场比赛中交出了.298/.403/.509的打击三围和14支本垒打。

旧金山巨人：Jonah Cox，外野手（已毕业于巨人Top 30）在2024年2月为送走Ross Stripling从运动家队交易而来后，Cox在其效力巨人系统的前两个赛季中打出了.261/.352/.386的成绩。在对右打挥棒做出调整并变得更具选球耐心后，他在双A和三亚的55场比赛中爆发，交出了.415/.468/.647的打击三围和34次盗垒。作为前大联盟捕手Darron Cox的儿子，他在过去三个多月的大部分时间里一直担任旧金山队的半主力球员。

圣迭戈教士：Bryan Balzer，右投手（第6名）Balzer的2025年首个完整赛季充满坎坷，在单A埃尔西诺湖（Lake Elsinore）的50局投球中自责分率高达7.92，WHIP为1.78。他不仅在单A和高阶单A将工作量几乎翻倍至98.2局，还取得了更好的成绩，期间交出了4.74的自责分率、1.39的WHIP以及100次三振。这位身高6尺1寸的右投手球速可达100英里/小时，并拥有通常维持在90英里/小时中段的两种直球。他时速80英里/小时中段的横扫滑球（sweeper）获得了最好的评价，同时他还投掷指叉球和卡特球来混淆打者视听。

科罗拉多洛矶：Cristian Arguelles，外野手（第5名）在2024年1月以700,000美元签约后，洛矶队安排Arguelles在多米尼加夏季联赛效力了两个赛季，随后才将他带到美国。在他的第二个夏天，他赢得了DSL的打击王（.422）和MVP荣誉，随后他又在ACL（亚利桑那综合联盟）以.402的打击率高居榜首，证明了自己并非仅凭DSL受益的打者，从而赢得了晋升至全赛季弗雷斯诺（Fresno）的机会。他在92场比赛中交出了.971的综合OPS，伴有44支长打（23支二垒安打、10支三垒安打、11支本垒打）、92分打点和15次盗垒。他的保送率（11.0%）几乎与三振率（12.0%）持平，并在今年交出了令人印象深刻的137的wRC+。

items.titleEn: Springer's Clemente Award nom has an extra personal touch
bodyEn: This story was excerpted from Keegan Matheson’s Blue Jays Beat newsletter. To read the full newsletter, click here. And subscribe to get it regularly in your inbox.

TORONTO -- George Springer has been named the Blue Jays’ nominee for the 2026 Roberto Clemente Award, recognizing the work he’s done in the community both this season and across his six seasons in Toronto.

The Roberto Clemente Award is the annual recognition of a Major League player who best represents the game of baseball through extraordinary character, community involvement, philanthropy and positive contributions, both on and off the field.
“This is an honor. Just to be mentioned in the same breath as him is an honor,” Springer said.

Major League Baseball held its annual Roberto Clemente Day on Sept. 15, when all players wore a No. 21 patch on their uniforms. Fans can vote on the award here and read the full bios for nominees from all 30 clubs, including Springer.
This is a meaningful nomination for Springer on multiple levels, and hits close to home as Springer is part Puerto Rican, home of the great Clemente.

“It’s special. My mom is from the island and the other half of my family is still there,” Springer said. “To be able to wear his number on that day, then to be in the same breath with not quite what he was doing, but the same style of stuff, that’s an honor for me.”

Springer is in the final year of his six-year, $150 million deal with the Blue Jays now, just a couple of days from his 37th birthday on Sept. 19. Brought to Toronto in 2021 as a cornerstone player to help elevate this organization’s young core, led by Vladimir Guerrero Jr. and Bo Bichette, Springer has been one of the faces of this organization ever since. Last year, in Game 7 of the ALCS against the Mariners, Springer’s home run gave him a moment that will live forever in the memories of Blue Jays fans.
Throughout his time in Toronto, Springer has also become involved with Jays Care, the charitable arm of the Blue Jays, and his own community outreach.

“For me, it’s a big part of who I am,” Springer said. “The whole goal for me is that I want to give back. I love to give back in any way that I can. The only way to do that is to go out in the community and show people that I’m a normal guy. I want to help, and anything that I can do, I will.”

Springer is a natural at these events. Much of the work he’s done through Jays Care or his own initiatives work with kids in the community, and at heart, Springer is the biggest kid in the Blue Jays’ clubhouse.
Earlier in his career with the Astros, Springer began to lay the groundwork for some of the community work he’s carried over to Toronto and Canada.

“Just follow your heart. Everybody has something that means something to them,” Springer said. “You can always use your platform and you can always be who you are. You can find a way to help somebody, whether it’s one person, five people or 100,000, it doesn’t matter. Be who you are. Guys have a lot of stuff that means something to them. If you want to get out, I’m sure you can find a person to help.”

For Springer, one of those causes close to his heart is helping kids who stutter. Springer has lived with a stutter since childhood, and now hosts the annual George Springer Bowling Benefit in Toronto, raising critical funds and awareness for Jays Care Foundation and the Stuttering Association for the Young (SAY).

“If you ask any of my teammates and coaches, it’s no secret. ... I like to talk,” Springer said at a 2024 event benefitting SAY. “I will talk your ear off all day, even if you don’t want me to. It didn’t used to be that way. For all of the kids or the parents who have a child who stutters, or has come across somebody who does, I hope that I can be proof that things do get easier. You can do what you want to do. You can say what you want to say. You can be who you want to be.”

Major League Baseball first began recognizing players for their philanthropic work in 1971, which was then called the “Commissioner’s Award.” The recognition was renamed to the “Roberto Clemente Award” in a 1973 tribute to Clemente following his tragic passing in a plane crash on New Year’s Eve in 1972 while delivering earthquake relief supplies to Nicaragua.
items.titleZh: Springer 的克莱门特奖提名有着特殊的个人意义
items.summaryZh: George Springer 入选 2026 年罗伯托·克莱门特奖多伦多蓝鸟队提名，这对有波多黎各血统的他意义非凡。
bodyZh: 本文摘自 Keegan Matheson 的 Blue Jays Beat 新闻通讯。要阅读完整通讯，请点击此处。并订阅以定期将其发送至您的收件箱。
多伦多报道 —— George Springer 被提名为多伦多蓝鸟队 2026 年罗伯托·克莱门特奖（Roberto Clemente Award）的人选，以表彰他在本赛季及效力多伦多六个赛季期间在社区做出的贡献。
罗伯托·克莱门特奖是一项年度表彰，旨在奖励在场上和场下都通过卓越品格、社区参与、慈善事业和积极贡献最好地代表棒球运动的大联盟球员。
“这是一种荣誉。能与他相提并论本身就是一种荣誉，”Springer 表示。
美国职业棒球大联盟于 9 月 15 日举办了年度罗伯托·克莱门特日，所有球员都在球衣上佩戴了 21 号臂章。球迷可以在此处对该奖项进行投票，并阅读包括 Springer 在内的全部 30 支俱乐部的提名人生平简介。
对 Springer 来说，这项提名在多个层面上都意义重大，并且触动内心深处，因为 Springer 的部分血统来自伟大的克莱门特故乡波多黎各。
“这很特别。我妈妈来自这个岛屿，我另一半的家人也还在那里，”Springer 说。“能够在那天穿上他的号码，然后能与他——虽然不完全是他的成就，但却是相同风格的事迹——相提并论，对我来说是一种荣誉。”

Springer 目前正处于与多伦多蓝鸟队六年 1.5 亿美元合同的最后一年，再过几天他将在 9 月 19 日迎来 37 岁生日。2021 年作为核心球员被引进多伦多，旨在帮助提升以 Vladimir Guerrero Jr. 和 Bo Bichette 为首的这支球队的年轻核心，自那以后 Springer 一直是这支球队的门面之一。去年，在对阵西雅图水手的美联冠军赛第七场比赛中，Springer 的本垒打为蓝鸟队球迷留下了永生难忘的时刻。
在多伦多效力期间，Springer 还积极参与了蓝鸟队的慈善机构 Jays Care 以及他自己的社区外展活动。
“对我来说，这是我身份的重要组成部分，”Springer 说。“我的整个目标就是我想回馈社会。我喜欢用任何我能做到的方式回馈社会。唯一的办法就是走入社区，向人们展示我是一个普通人。我想提供帮助，任何我能做的事，我都会去做。”
Springer 在这些活动中表现得自然大方。他通过 Jays Care 或自己的倡议所做的大部分工作都是与社区中的儿童合作，而在内心深处，Springer 是蓝鸟队休息室里最大的孩子。
在他的职业生涯早期效力休斯敦太空人时，Springer 就开始为他后来带到多伦多和加拿大的部分社区工作奠定基础。
“追随你的内心。每个人都有对自己有意义的事情，”Springer 说。“你总是可以利用你的平台，你也总能做你自己。你可以找到帮助别人的方法，无论是帮助一个人、五个人还是十万人，这都没关系。做你自己。球员们有很多对自己有意义的事情。如果你想走出去，我确信你能找到一个需要帮助的人。”
对 Springer 来说，他心系的事业之一就是帮助口吃儿童。Springer 从童年起就一直受口吃困扰，现在他在多伦多主办年度 George Springer 保龄球慈善赛，为 Jays Care 基金会和美国口吃协会（SAY）筹集关键资金和提高意识。
“如果你问我的任何队友和教练，这都不是秘密……我喜欢说话，”Springer 在 2024 年一场支持 SAY 的活动上说。“我会跟你聊上一整天，即使你不想听。过去可不是这样的。对于所有口吃或遇到过口吃儿童的家长和孩子，我希望我能成为证明事情会变好的证据。你可以做你想做的事。你可以说你想说的话。你可以成为你想成为的人。”
美国职业棒球大联盟于 1971 年首次开始表彰球员的慈善工作，当时被称为“专员奖”（Commissioner's Award）。为了纪念克莱门特在 1972 年除夕夜向尼加拉瓜运送地震救援物资时因飞机失事而不幸遇难，该奖项于 1973 年更名为“罗伯托·克莱门特奖”。

items.titleEn: Blue Jays face tougher postseason path but there's still 'plenty of baseball'
bodyEn: TORONTO -- The Blue Jays salvaged one game from their series against the Tigers, but they’ve left themselves with some serious work to do.

Wednesday afternoon’s 5-1 win at Rogers Centre leaves the Blue Jays 1 1/2 games back of the final AL Wild Card spot, now held by the White Sox. The Rangers are also in a tie with the Blue Jays and play later tonight before they host Toronto for a major series in Arlington beginning on Friday.

“We’ll try to go 1-0 every day,” manager John Schneider said, sticking to his mantra. “That’s it. It’s going to be another tough series. It will be a good off-day for everyone tomorrow, but every day and every series is going to be tough and really important.”
This is what mattered most from Wednesday’s win and the crowded Wild Card race:
1. A brand-new AL Wild Card picture
The flip atop the AL Central is crucial to the Blue Jays and their postseason hopes. The Guardians now lead the Central, dropping the White Sox back into the Wild Card race in the final spot.

The White Sox begin a four-game series against the Tigers on Thursday at home. After the opener in that series, both the White Sox and Blue Jays have nine games remaining, so we’ll be able to deal in round numbers again. The key to all of this, though, is the tiebreaker.

Chicago holds the tiebreaker over Toronto, which changes the equation. Toronto held the tiebreaker over Cleveland, which meant that a tie for the third Wild Card spot would have been enough, but that’s no longer the case if the Blue Jays are chasing Chicago. Texas is also right in the middle of this race now, and Toronto does not hold the tiebreaker there, either.

The simple version? The Blue Jays can no longer back their way into this. The clock is running too low now, and the underwhelming AL Wild Card race will no longer keep them afloat. The only path to the postseason is for the Blue Jays to go on a run.
2. Scherzer helps keep the hope alive

Max Scherzer is pitching in these spots because the Blue Jays need him to. This rotation has been decimated by injuries, so the 6.38 ERA that Scherzer carried into Wednesday’s game didn’t matter much. The Blue Jays needed the future Hall of Famer to give them a chance, and that’s exactly what he did.

Scherzer’s velocity hovered below his 2026 norms and his control wasn’t pinpoint, but that didn’t matter much, either. The 42-year-old held the Tigers off long enough for the Blue Jays’ bats to break through in the middle innings, a rock-solid performance given the circumstances.

“We have work to do,” Scherzer said. “It takes all of us, not only the starting staff, but the bullpen, the hitters. We have to win ballgames. Our backs are against the wall. We’ve got to come out fighting and clawing, and keep finding ways to win ballgames.”

Getting through five innings of one-run ball was crucial, too, with how worn out the Blue Jays’ bullpen is. Thursday’s off-day comes at a very welcome time; then the Blue Jays will roll out Dylan Cease and José Soriano in their first two games against the Rangers on Friday and Saturday, another aggressive move as they try to max out the opportunity still in front of them.
3. The offense landed enough jabs
The Blue Jays’ best offense was the Tigers’ atrocious defense at times, but before that mess of errors in the sixth inning, Toronto also came up with some timely hitting.
No. 9 hitter Myles Straw had the biggest swing of the game, a go-ahead RBI single in the fourth, and Straw is proving that he belongs in the lineup as often as the matchups allow down the stretch.
“Today was huge,” Straw said. “That was like a must-win, but obviously, we’ve got nine more. Anything can happen. That’s plenty of baseball.”

To go on a true run, though -- which is what Toronto needs at this point -- there needs to be some power. This team can win the 2-1 and 4-2 games, but if this pitching staff falters again, the Blue Jays need to be able to win a slugfest, which hasn’t come naturally to them in 2026.
items.titleZh: 蓝鸟面临更艰难的季后赛之路但仍有大量比赛要打
items.summaryZh: 多伦多蓝鸟在战胜底特律老虎后，仍在美联外卡争夺战中落后，球队必须全力冲刺以争取季后赛席位。
bodyZh: 多伦多讯 —— 多伦多蓝鸟从对阵底特律老虎的系列赛中挽回了一场胜利，但他们面前仍有艰巨的任务要完成。
周三下午在罗杰斯中心取得的 5-1 胜利，让多伦多蓝鸟在美联最后一个外卡席位上落后 1.5 场胜差，该席位目前由芝加哥白袜占据。得克萨斯游骑兵目前也与多伦多蓝鸟战绩持平，他们将在今晚稍晚进行比赛，随后于周五开始在阿灵顿迎战多伦多，展开关键系列赛。
“我们每天都会争取拿下 1-0，”总教练 John Schneider 坚持他的口号说道。“就这样。这将是又一个艰难的系列赛。明天大家会有一个很好的休息日，但每一天和每一个系列赛都会很艰难且非常重要。”
以下是周三的胜利以及拥挤的外卡争夺战中最重要的事情：
1. 全新美联外卡格局
美联中区榜首的易主对多伦多蓝鸟及其季后赛希望至关重要。克利夫兰守护者目前领跑中区，将芝加哥白袜挤回了外卡争夺战的最后一个席位。
芝加哥白袜将于周四在主场开始与底特律老虎的四场系列赛。在该系列赛的首战之后，芝加哥白袜和多伦多蓝鸟都还剩九场比赛，因此我们可以再次以整数来计算。不过，这一切的关键在于对战胜负优势（tiebreaker）。
芝加哥对多伦多拥有对战优势，这改变了局势。多伦多对克利夫兰拥有对战优势，这意味着在第三外卡席位上战平就足够了，但如果多伦多蓝鸟是在追赶芝加哥，情况便不再如此。得克萨斯目前也深陷这场争夺战中，而多伦多在那里也没有对战优势。
简单来说？多伦多蓝鸟再也不能靠运气混进去了。时间已经不多了，表现平平的美联外卡争夺战已无法再保佑他们。通往季后赛的唯一途径是多伦多蓝鸟打出一波连胜。
2. Max Scherzer 帮助延续希望
Max Scherzer 在这些关键时刻登板投球，因为多伦多蓝鸟需要他。先发轮值已经遭到伤病的严重打击，因此 Max Scherzer 在周三比赛前带有的 6.38 自责分率已经不太重要了。多伦多蓝鸟需要这位未来的名人堂球员给他们一个机会，而他做到了这一点。
Max Scherzer 的球速徘徊在他 2026 年的正常水平之下，他的控球也并非精准无比，但这其实也不太重要。这位 42 岁的投手将底特律老虎压制了足够长的时间，让多伦多蓝鸟的打线在比赛中段得以突破，考虑到当时的情况，这是一场表现稳健的投球。
“我们还有工作要做，”Max Scherzer 说。“这需要我们所有人的努力，不仅是先发投手群，还有牛棚和打者。我们必须赢得比赛。我们已经退无可退。我们必须全力以赴、奋力拼搏，并不断寻找赢得比赛的方法。”
考虑到多伦多蓝鸟牛棚的疲惫程度，投满五局且仅失一分至关重要。周四的休息日来得非常及时；接着多伦多蓝鸟将在周五和周六对阵得克萨斯游骑兵的前两场比赛中派出 Dylan Cease 和 José Soriano，这是他们试图最大化眼前机会的又一个积极举动。
3. 进攻端提供了足够的火力
多伦多蓝鸟最好的进攻有时是底特律老虎糟糕的防守，但在第六局那一团混乱的失误之前，多伦多也打出了几支关键安打。
第九棒打者 Myles Straw 打出了全场最大的一支安打，在第四局敲出一支超前打点安打，Myles Straw 正在证明他在之后的比赛中只要对阵情况允许，就应该留在先发阵容中。
“今天非常关键，”Myles Straw 说。“这就像是一场必须赢的比赛，但显然我们还有九场。什么事情都可能发生。还有大量的比赛要打。”
不过，要想打出一波真正的连胜 —— 这正是目前多伦多所需要的 —— 就必须展现一些长打能力。这支球队能赢得 2-1 和 4-2 的比赛，但如果这个投手群再次表现不稳，多伦多蓝鸟就需要有能力赢得一场大比分的对攻战，这在 2026 年对他们来说并不是轻而易举的事。

items.titleEn: Yesavage struggles in Triple-A rehab start, but could still return next week
bodyEn: TORONTO -- Trey Yesavage made a rehab start with the Triple-A Buffalo Bisons Tuesday night, setting up the star right-hander to return just in time for the final week of the season.
Yesavage has been rehabbing from surgery he underwent earlier in August to repair the meniscus in his left knee, but has been ramping up quickly to help a rotation that desperately needs it.

Anthony Santander was also scheduled to play in Tuesday’s game, but he’s now dealing with some lower back discomfort. Santander, who’s trying to come back from shoulder surgery undergone earlier this year, has played in just two rehab games and has been out of the Bisons’ lineup since Friday, so it continues to look extremely challenging for him to get back in time to make an impact.
Yesavage has a shot, though. This is what you need to know:
How did Yesavage perform?This didn’t go as planned.

Yesavage couldn’t get out of the first inning, allowing two runs (one earned) on a pair of hits and a walk, which ran his pitch count up to 34 before he could record the third out. The Blue Jays wisely chose to remove Yesavage instead of pushing him closer to 40 pitches in a single frame.

The Blue Jays had been hoping for 40-45 pitches, and while it’s still possible for Yesavage to throw a few more pitches off to the side, this isn’t what anyone had in mind. Yesavage’s four-seam fastball averaged 93.3 mph, which is just 1 mph south of his 2026 average in the big leagues and no cause for concern.
What’s next?Question one: Do the Blue Jays feel that Tuesday was just a blip for the rehabbing Yesavage, and continue to trust that he’s ready to return to the big leagues?

If that’s a “yes,” then the final hurdle comes Wednesday, when the Blue Jays get a better sense for how Yesavage’s knee (and arm) have bounced back from his first real game action since Aug. 4. As long as that all checks out, though, the Blue Jays could use Yesavage in a bulk role their next trip through the rotation.

Manager John Schneider has also said that it will be more tempting to give Yesavage a “start” in this situation, meaning he’d pitch the first three or four innings, instead of coming in after an opener.
What are they saying?When Schneider was looking ahead to Yesavage’s rehab start over the weekend, it was clear that he wouldn’t be picking apart the box score.

“Just feeling good physically,” Schneider said. “We want to see his stuff be normal. I don’t really care about results. We know what he can do here. Just make sure that he comes out of it feeling good physically. So far, so good with the bullpens and the lives, so that’s all I’m looking at.”

What else?This weekend in Texas, the Blue Jays tentatively plan to open the series with Spencer Arrighetti, who’s essentially been built up to a full starter’s workload at this point. Coming out of Thursday’s off-day, the Blue Jays could also be aggressive with their bullpen usage in that game if needed.

Dylan Cease is scheduled for Saturday, followed by José Soriano in the Sunday finale, which leads us to the obvious spot for Yesavage on Monday, when the Blue Jays open their series in Baltimore against the Orioles.

Taking this a step further, that rotation setup could leave Yesavage in line to pitch on the final day of the season against the Reds at home at Rogers Centre. Given how tight the AL Wild Card race is, that could be a deciding game for the Blue Jays.
items.titleZh: Yesavage在小联盟3A复健赛表现挣扎，但仍有望于下周回归
items.summaryZh: 多伦多蓝鸟投手Yesavage在3A复健赛中表现挣扎，但球队仍可能安排他在下周重返大联盟。
bodyZh: 多伦多讯——Trey Yesavage于周二晚间代表小联盟3A水牛城野牛出战复健赛，这位星级右投有望在常规赛收官阶段及时复出。
Yesavage此前因左膝半月板修复手术一直在进行复健，该手术于8月初进行。为了支援急需人手的先发轮值，他的恢复进程一直在加速推进。
Anthony Santander原本也计划在周二的比赛中出场，但他目前正受到下背部不适的困扰。Santander正试图从今年早些时候接受的肩膀手术中恢复，他此前仅参加了两场复健赛，自周五以来就一直缺席野牛队的阵容，因此他想赶回并在球队中发挥作用看起来依然极具挑战。
不过，Yesavage仍有机会。以下是你需要了解的内容：
Yesavage表现如何？过程并不如计划中顺利。
Yesavage未能投完第一局，他在送出两支安打和一次保送后失掉2分（其中1分自责分），在取得第三个出局数之前，其投球数就已经达到了34球。蓝鸟明智地选择将Yesavage换下，而不是让他在单局内投球数接近40球。
蓝鸟此前希望他能投40到45球，尽管Yesavage仍然有可能在场边多投几球，但这并不是任何人所期望的。Yesavage的四缝线速球平均球速为93.3英里，仅比他2026赛季在大联盟的平均球速低1英里，这并不值得担忧。
下一步是什么？第一个问题：蓝鸟是否认为周二只是处于复健中的Yesavage的一次小波折，并继续相信他已经准备好重返大联盟？
如果答案是“肯定的”，那么最后一道关卡将在周三到来。届时，蓝鸟将进一步了解Yesavage的膝盖（以及手臂）在经历自8月4日以来的首场真实比赛后恢复得如何。只要这一切都没问题，蓝鸟在下一轮轮值时就可以让Yesavage担任长中继角色。
总教练John Schneider也表示，在这种情况下给Yesavage一次“先发”机会更有吸引力，这意味着他将投前三到四局，而不是在假先发之后登板。
他们是怎么说的？当Schneider在周末展望Yesavage的复健赛时，很明显他不会去纠结比赛的数据。
“身体感觉良好最重要，”Schneider说道。“我们希望看到他的球威恢复正常。我其实不在乎结果。我们知道他在这里能做到什么。只要确保他赛后身体感觉良好就行。到目前为止，牛棚和实战投球的表现都很好，所以我关注的就是这些。”
还有什么？本周末在得克萨斯，蓝鸟初步计划由Spencer Arrighetti开启系列赛，他目前基本上已经达到了完整先发投手的投球工作量。度过周四的休息日后，如果需要的话，蓝鸟在周四的比赛中也可能会积极调度牛棚。
Dylan Cease预计在周六先发，随后的周日收官战由José Soriano先发，这自然让人将Yesavage的复工时间指向了周一，届时蓝鸟将在客场对阵巴尔的摩金莺开启系列赛。
更进一步来看，这样的轮值安排意味着Yesavage有望在常规赛最后一天在罗杰斯中心主场对阵辛辛那提红人时登板投球。鉴于美联外卡竞争如此激烈，那可能会是蓝鸟的一场决定性比赛。

items.titleEn: Blue Jays' stumble continues as Wild Card spot starts to slip away
bodyEn: TORONTO -- Already stuck in a dreadful night of their own, the out-of-town scoreboard turned on the Blue Jays.

As the Blue Jays trudged through the eighth inning of their own 10-1 loss to the Tigers, the Guardians walked off the White Sox in Cleveland, causing a massive shift in the AL Wild Card race. Now, the Blue Jays are two games back of the Guardians for the final Wild Card spot with just 10 games remaining in their 2026 season.
“Every game is a playoff game at this point,” said Ernie Clement.
This is what mattered most Tuesday night:
1. The AL Wild Card Race
The Blue Jays (75-77) have leaned on the mediocrity of the AL Wild Card race for long enough, and up until the Guardians walked it off, it looked like that would keep them afloat for another night.

The Blue Jays are being given every possible opportunity to stay alive and close this gap, but no matter how long this drags on, it keeps dangling a few inches out of their grasp. The third Wild Card spot has gone to teams with 87, 86, 89 and 86 wins in the past four seasons, but at this point, it’s starting to feel like 83 wins could even sneak a team through. The Blue Jays don’t just need a strong finish -- they need to go on a serious run.

This gets even more interesting now that the Rangers (75-76) have launched themselves back into the race and are a half-game up on the Blue Jays (1 1/2 back of the Guardians). The Blue Jays travel to Arlington after this series to play three against the Rangers beginning on Friday, which could define this season for either club. The Blue Jays do not hold the head-to-head tiebreaker over the Rangers, if it eventually comes down to that.
2. They were one pitch away!

Earlier in the fourth inning, before it all unraveled on the Blue Jays, Michael Lorenzen had Riley Greene in an 0-2 count with two outs, one strike away from the Blue Jays’ bullpen carrying a no-hitter into the fifth inning. Greene eventually grinded out a walk, though, and Eduardo Valencia happily accepted his own free pass on four consecutive balls.

After Max Clark’s RBI double for the first Tigers hit of the night, Spencer Torkelson finally blew the game wide open with a three-run shot on a sweeper from Lorenzen that caught too much of the plate. This one was a no-doubter, loud and sky-high off the bat.

“The score got out of hand,” manager John Schneider said. “The turning point: a two-out walk in an 0-2 count to Greene, and they score four. It unraveled from there with a couple of mistakes and we just didn’t score. That’s what it boils down to.”

The margins are so thin now, and all of these games feel like they have a dozen moments we could reach back for 10 games from now. Clark, Torkelson and the Tigers deserve every bit of credit for their approach against Lorenzen, which eventually earned Torkelson the pitch he launched to left field, but the Blue Jays need to slam the door shut when it’s already that close.
3. The offense? It wasn’t close

Hours before the game, John Schneider said that the most important thing on a bullpen day is scoring. That sounds too obvious, but there’s something to it. If the Blue Jays get some early offense, Schneider can be more proactive and map out his bullpen game from a position of power, instead of just letting his starter ride for six innings and seeing where the chips fall. Without that offense, the Blue Jays were chasing, which is such an unnatural spot for a bullpen to be in.
This wasn’t for a lack of chances. Alejandro Kirk had a shot with the bases loaded in the fourth, but the handful of opportunities didn’t add up to anything.
“It was just to the short end of the bat, really. You look up, and it’s three singles,” Schneider said. “It’s tough to generate offense that way.”

Lately, the flashes have been encouraging, from Vladimir Guerrero Jr.’s home run over the weekend to Kazuma Okamoto, who continues to have an excellent season and be the lone source of legitimate power in this lineup. At this point, though, there’s zero room left for this offense to have another night like this.
“We just have to find a way,” Clement said. “We have to find a way to come back with energy tomorrow and take this one game at a time.”
items.titleZh: 蓝鸟低迷持续，外卡席位渐行渐远
items.summaryZh: 多伦多蓝鸟以1比10惨败给底特律老虎，在美联外卡争夺战中落后守护者2个胜场。
bodyZh: 多伦多报道——多伦多蓝鸟自己正深陷糟糕的夜晚，而外地球场的分数板也对他们落井下石。
正当蓝鸟以1比10惨败给底特律老虎并艰难度过第八局时，克利夫兰守护者在主场对芝加哥白袜完成了再见安打，导致美联外卡争夺战发生巨大变动。目前，在2026赛季仅剩10场比赛之际，蓝鸟距离最终的外卡席位已经落后2个胜场。
Ernie Clement表示：“在这个阶段，每一场比赛都是季后赛。”
这是周二晚上最为关键的事情：
1. 美联外卡争夺战
多伦多蓝鸟（75胜77负）靠着美联外卡争夺战中各队的平庸表现撑了足够久，直到守护者打出再见安打前，看起来这还能让他们再撑一个晚上。
蓝鸟获得了所有可能的机会来保持生机并缩小差距，但无论这拖延了多久，它总是距离他们的掌控差了几英寸。过去四个赛季中，第三个外卡席位分别被取得87胜、86胜、89胜和86胜的球队获得，但在此阶段，看起来甚至83胜的球队都能偷袭晋级。蓝鸟不仅需要一个强劲的收官——他们需要打出一波真正的连胜高潮。
鉴于得克萨斯游骑兵（75胜76负）已经重新杀回争夺战，且领先蓝鸟半个胜场（落后守护者1.5个胜场），局势变得更加有趣。蓝鸟在本系列赛结束后将前往阿灵顿，从周五开始与游骑兵进行三场比赛，这可能会决定两队本赛季的命运。如果最终要通过胜负关系决定排名，蓝鸟对游骑兵并不占优。
2. 他们离成功只差一个球！
此前在第四局，在蓝鸟崩盘之前，Michael Lorenzen面对Riley Greene时取得了0好2坏的球数领先，距离蓝鸟牛棚将无安打局带入第五局只差一个好球。不过Greene最终拼出了一次保送，随后Eduardo Valencia也欣然接受了连续四个坏球的保送。
在Max Clark敲出本场老虎的第一支安打（带有一分打点的二垒安打）后，Spencer Torkelson最终凭借Lorenzen投出的一颗红中偏多的滑球轰出三分本垒打，彻底将比赛打花。这一球毫无悬念，击球声音响亮且直冲云霄。
总教练John Schneider表示：“比分失控了。转折点是：在0好2坏的情况下对Greene投出四坏保送，然后他们得了四分。从那以后，随着几次失误，局势开始崩盘，而我们只是未能得分。事情归根结底就是这样。”
目前的容错空间非常微小，所有这些比赛感觉都有十几个瞬间，会在10场比赛后让我们频频回首。Clark、Torkelson和老虎队对Michael Lorenzen的进攻策略完全值得赞赏，这最终为Torkelson赢得了轰向左外野的那球，但当局面已经如此胶着时，蓝鸟需要彻底将大门关死。
3. 进攻呢？差得十万八千里
在比赛开始前几个小时，John Schneider表示牛棚日最重要的事情就是得分。这听起来过于显而易见，但确实有其道理。如果蓝鸟能在早期取得进水，Schneider就能更加主动地从优势地位来排兵布阵，而不是让先发投手硬投六局然后看运气如何。没有了进攻支援，蓝鸟就只能苦苦追赶，这对于牛棚来说是一个极其不自然的处境。
这并不是因为缺少机会。Alejandro Kirk在第四局曾在满垒时有过一次机会，但寥寥几次机会最终都化为乌有。
Schneider说：“真的只是击球不够扎实。你抬头一看，全是短程安打。用这种方式来制造进攻很艰难。”
最近，一些闪光点令人鼓舞，从Vladimir Guerrero Jr.周末的本垒打，到Kazuma Okamoto继续保持着出色的赛季表现并成为这支打线中唯一的强打火力源泉。然而，在这个阶段，这支打线的进攻已经完全没有空间再经历这样一个夜晚了。
Clement说：“我们必须找到方法。我们必须找到方法在明天带着能量卷土重来，一场一场地去拼。”

items.titleEn: Here are the 2026 Single-A All-Stars and award winners
bodyEn: Minor Leaguers get their first taste of full-season ball at Single-A, and it's often a springboard for breakout campaigns. That was very much the case this year, with memorable showings across the California, Carolina and Florida State Leagues. On Tuesday, Minor League Baseball announced its 2026 end-of-season All-Stars and award winners.

There were plenty of big names across Single-A, including Pirates right-hander Seth Hernandez, Rockies outfielder/second baseman Roldy Brito and Brewers shortstop Brady Ebel. That trio earned Top MLB Prospect honors in their respective leagues as Dodgers first baseman Easton Shelton, Rays shortstop Cooper Flemming and Marlins infielder Echedry Vargas were named MVP.
Here is a full breakdown of the hardware awarded across Single-A:
California League
Most Valuable Player: Easton Shelton, Ontario (LAD)

To say that Shelton was the most dominant player in the California League would certainly be an understatement. The non-drafted free agent out of powerhouse Bishop Gorman High School in Las Vegas paced the circuit with 37 home runs -- 16 more than any other player. His 1.047 OPS was 151 points higher than anyone else, and his 112 RBIs were tops by 26. He did have the second-most strikeouts, but the 20-year-old's offensive impact was undeniable.
Pitcher of the Year: Brady Parker, Fresno (COL)

Parker's debut season was a smashing success after he signed for $1500,000 as a 2025 11th-rounder out of Houston-Victoria. The 6-foot-2 southpaw spent much of the first half in the bullpen but really took off when he moved into the Grizzlies' rotation in June. Across 112 1/3 innings, he led the circuit with 152 strikeouts, a 3.61 ERA and a .219 average against. The 22-year-old had an 18-inning scoreless streak in the first half and gave up one or no earned runs in half of his 26 outings.
Top MLB Prospect: Roldy Brito, Fresno (COL)

Brito joined Fresno late last season and thrived (.905) in 33 games. He carried that over to a dynamic 2026 campaign in which he slashed .327/.390/.506 with eight homers and 18 steals in 79 games before earning a promotion to High-A Spokane. The 19-year-old Dominican Republic native enterred the Top 100 prospect list in April -- he now ranks No. 54 -- and started in the All-Star Futures Game. He showed immense versatility, switch-hitting and splitting his time defensively between center field and second base.
All-Star Team

Carolina League
Most Valuable Player: Cooper Flemming, Charleston (TB)

The RiverDogs' lineup was loaded with 2025 Draft picks this season, and Flemming, selected 53rd overall, stood out above the rest. The former Vanderbilt commit used added weight from over the offseason to become a well-rounded offensive force as he led the Carolina League in hits (133), doubles (29) and RBIs (79) while posting an .829 OPS that ranked fifth. The left-handed hitter showed a mature approach at the plate and received high marks for his makeup.
Pitcher of the Year: Aidan Cremarosa, Charleston (TB)

Cremarosa had one of the best outings of the Minor League season, an 11-strikeout no-hitter that was the Minors' first solo nine-inning effort since Aug. 20, 2022. However, his season was so much more than that one brilliant outing. The 2025 eighth-rounder paced Carolina League pitchers (min. 70 IP) with a 23.8 percent K-BB rate and a 0.90 WHIP, ranked second in FIP (3.02) and finished sixth in ERA (2.82).
Top MLB Prospect: Brady Ebel, Wilson (MIL)

After the Brewers drafted him 32nd overall in 2025, Ebel struggled in 16 games for Single-A Wilson. The California native returned to play for the relocated Wilson Warbirds and was a revelation as he paced the circuit with a .417 on-base percentage and 96 walks while ranking fourth with a .837 OPS and playing solid shortstop defense. Ebel earned a promotion to High-A in August and cracked the Top 100 in August -- he currently ranks as MLB's No. 97 prospect.

Florida State League
Most Valuable Player: Echedry Vargas, Jupiter (MIA)

Vargas long stood out for his ability to create hard contact when the Marlins acquired him as part of the Jake Burger trade in December 2024. He's taken that to another level in his second season in Miami's farm system. The 21-year-old paced the Florida State League in homers (27), slugging percentage (.611), OPS (.983), hits (121) and RBIs (94) -- many by a wide margin. Originally signed as a shortstop, Vargas played all four infield positions this season, primarily the infield corners.
Pitcher of the Year: Henry Lalane, Tampa (NYY)

Lalane has long tantalized with his combination of size and stuff, and things finally clicked for the 6-foot-7 lefty in 2026. Among Florida State League pitchers with at least 60 innings, he was first in K-BB rate (23.9 percent), FIP (2.63) and WHIP (0.99) and second in ERA (2.74). In his final five starts before a promotion to High-A -- and subsequent trade to the Giants -- the 22-year-old gave up just five runs over 35 1/3 innings with 50 K's to 10 walks.
Top MLB Prospect: Seth Hernandez, Bradenton (PIT)

Herandez's pro debut was breathtaking from the first pitch -- a 102.4 mph "beam of light" at the Pirates' Spring Breakout game. That brilliance carried over to Bradenton, where the 6-foot-4 righty averaged 97.1 mph on his fastball and picked up 50 strikeouts in 28 innings with just a 0.96 ERA and 0.94 WHIP. What's more, the former Vanderbilt commit didn't give up a hit in half of his outings with the Marauders. The seventh overall pick in the 2025 Draft is the top right-handed pitching prospect in the game and No. 7 overall.
